packageRules.description: Python deps (requirements*.txt via pip_requirements, pyproject.toml/uv.lock via pep621): automerge minor/patch once CI is green. platformAutomerge is disabled repo-wide (see top-level setting) so Renovate polls GitHub check statuses itself instead of relying on GitHub's native auto-merge, which would need branch protection with required status checks to actually block on a red CI - this repo has none.
GitHub Actions: automerge minor/patch once CI is green. Same platformAutomerge:false rationale as the Python rule above.
Major versions (Python deps + GitHub Actions) always stay manual: PR opened, never automerged. Explicit even though automerge defaults to false, to make the policy self-documenting.

Group the docker/* GitHub Actions used in .github/workflows/release.yml (setup-qemu-action, setup-buildx-action, login-action, metadata-action, build-push-action) into a single PR - they're versioned and released together upstream and have historically bumped as a batch.

Do not manage this repo's own published image. ghcr.io/pixibixi/freshrss-summary in docker-compose.yml and helm/freshrss-summary/values.yaml is the artifact this repo builds and publishes (release.yml), not a third-party dependency - Renovate must not open bump PRs against it.
